Aliases: Phone-first page|Tradesperson homepage|Call now page
Keywords: plumber, electrician, tradesperson, call, phone, local, service area, quote, reviews
Section Order: Phone number and one-line promise > Services with starting prices > Service area and hours > Recent jobs with real photos > Reviews with names and towns > Accreditations > Short quote form > Footer with number again
Primary CTA Placement: A tap-to-call button in the header and again after the services; a quote form further down for people who will not phone
Color Strategy: One calm brand colour and one warm signal colour reserved for the phone button; plain light background so the number reads in daylight
Recommended Effects: Sticky call bar on phones; hover and focus states only; no video hero
Conversion Optimization: Show the number as text, not only in an image; state call-out hours and a reply time you will keep; put the licence or insurance line next to the first button; log taps on the call link to see what works
Use When: The owner's best leads arrive by phone and the work is booked from a conversation
Avoid When: The business needs a priced online basket or a long-term schedule built by the customer
Mobile: Call bar fixed to the bottom, 48 px tall, with the number as its label; form fields use the right keyboard types
Accessibility: Call link has the number as visible text (SC 2.4.4); target at least 24 px, aim for 44 (SC 2.5.8); contrast 4.5:1 on the signal colour (SC 1.4.3)
Slop Habits: stock photo of a smiling man with a wrench; three icon cards for 'fast, reliable, local'; a pulsing live dot when nobody is on call

Aliases: 24 hour call out|Urgent repair page|Burst pipe page|Lockout page
Keywords: emergency, urgent, 24 hour, call out, lockout, burst pipe, no heating, same day, rescue
Section Order: Number and honest arrival time > What to do while you wait (three safe steps) > What we fix > Call-out price or how it is worked out > Coverage map or town list > One review about a night call > Form for non-urgent work
Primary CTA Placement: Giant tap-to-call at the very top and fixed at the bottom; nothing competes with it above the fold
Color Strategy: High-contrast pair with one alarm-adjacent accent kept for the call button only; no decorative colour
Recommended Effects: None beyond focus and press states; page must paint fast on a weak signal
Conversion Optimization: Answer who comes, how soon and what it costs before anything else; state when the line is staffed and what happens after hours; keep the page under a few requests so it loads on 3G
Use When: Customers arrive in a crisis, usually on a phone, and decide in seconds
Avoid When: The service is planned work; use a quote or booking page instead
Mobile: The whole page is one thumb zone; no carousel, no menu needed beyond a link home
Accessibility: Calm plain language for stressed readers; no auto-playing media (SC 2.2.2); phone link readable by screen readers
Slop Habits: countdown timers that are not real; 'we are available 24/7' with a voicemail behind it; red flashing banners

Aliases: Get a quote|Estimate request|Free estimate page|Request a price
Keywords: quote, estimate, request, price, form, project, job details, photos, builder, decorator, mover
Section Order: What we quote for and typical price ranges > The short form > What happens next with times > Examples of past quotes > Reviews > Accreditations > Questions about pricing
Primary CTA Placement: The form itself sits in the first screen on wide screens and one tap away on phones
Color Strategy: Neutral page, one action colour on the submit button, success state in a second colour that passes contrast
Recommended Effects: Inline validation messages; a clear sent state; no animated form chrome
Conversion Optimization: Ask for name, contact, postcode and one line about the job first; make photo upload optional; say who reads it and how fast you reply; give a price range so cheap and costly leads sort themselves
Use When: Price depends on the job and the owner prices each one by hand
Avoid When: Prices are fixed and public; show them and let people book
Mobile: One column, labels above fields, correct input types, submit button full width
Accessibility: Visible labels, errors tied to fields and described in text (SC 3.3.1, 3.3.3); do not require the same data twice (SC 3.3.7)
Slop Habits: a ten-field form up front; 'get your free quote in 60 seconds' with no promise behind it; captcha puzzles that block real customers

Aliases: Book online|Appointment scheduler|Reserve a slot|Online booking
Keywords: booking, appointment, schedule, slot, calendar, reserve, dentist, salon, clinic, studio, deposit
Section Order: Services with length and price > Pick a time > Your details > Confirm and deposit if any > Sent state with calendar file > Cancel and change rules > Contact for questions
Primary CTA Placement: The slot picker is the page; a Book button in the header jumps to it
Color Strategy: Quiet page; availability shown by text and shape as well as colour; one accent for the chosen slot
Recommended Effects: Instant selection feedback; skeleton while slots load; no decorative transitions
Conversion Optimization: Show the next free slot without clicking; keep it to three steps; send a confirmation and a reminder; state the cancellation rule before payment; offer a phone fallback
Use When: The owner sells time in fixed lengths and wants fewer back and forth calls
Avoid When: Jobs need a site visit first; use a quote request
Mobile: Day strip scrolls sideways with visible scroll cue; slots are large tap targets
Accessibility: Calendar works by keyboard and has a text list alternative; no drag required (SC 2.5.7); time zone stated in words
Slop Habits: a calendar widget that is a grey iframe; slots shown only by green and red; a login wall before showing times

Aliases: Health practice page|Surgery homepage|Practitioner page
Keywords: clinic, dentist, physio, chiropractor, optician, practitioner, registered, appointment, new patients, insurance
Section Order: Booking button and phone > Who we treat and how > The practitioners with registration numbers > First visit step by step > Prices and insurance > Location, parking, step-free access > Reviews > Privacy note
Primary CTA Placement: Book in the header and after the first-visit section; phone beside it
Color Strategy: Soft cool neutrals with one clear action colour; avoid clinical white glare by using a slightly tinted ground
Recommended Effects: Calm hover and focus; one gentle reveal at most
Conversion Optimization: Name the people and their registration; say what the first visit costs; show access details; make new-patient booking as easy as returning
Use When: Patients choose a practice by trust and convenience
Avoid When: The service is an app for remote care; see the telehealth patterns
Mobile: Address and phone are tap links; opening hours show today's hours first
Accessibility: Plain-language health text; access information written out; forms avoid cognitive tests (SC 3.3.8)
Slop Habits: stock photo of a doctor holding a clipboard; claims such as 'pain-free' that nobody can promise; a tooth icon above every heading

Aliases: Firm homepage|Law firm page|Accountant page|Advisor page
Keywords: law, solicitor, accountant, tax, adviser, consultant, enquiry, consultation, fees, regulated
Section Order: Who you help and the problem in plain words > Services and fees > People with credentials > How an engagement runs > Short case notes with permission > Regulation and complaints line > Enquiry form or call
Primary CTA Placement: Book a first call after the problem statement and at the end; phone in header
Color Strategy: Deep restrained colour with warm neutral ground; no gold gradients
Recommended Effects: Calm: focus and hover; one soft reveal
Conversion Optimization: State the fee shape (fixed, hourly, free first call); show the regulator and number; write the process as steps the client takes; avoid legal jargon above the fold
Use When: Clients are buying judgement and need to feel safe before they call
Avoid When: The firm sells self-service documents; use pricing and checkout patterns
Mobile: Short paragraphs, phone and email links in the footer, enquiry form with few fields
Accessibility: Reading level checked; headings in order (SC 1.3.1); contrast 4.5:1
Slop Habits: scales of justice icons; handshake photos; 'trusted by thousands' with no source

Aliases: Cafe homepage|Restaurant page|Menu page|Pub page
Keywords: menu, cafe, restaurant, bakery, brewery, opening hours, location, reserve, takeaway, food
Section Order: Today's hours and address > Photo of the room or the food > Menu as real text > Book or order link > Story in two sentences > Allergen note > Map and how to arrive > Reviews with sources
Primary CTA Placement: Reserve or order button under the hero; address and hours in text near the top
Color Strategy: Colours drawn from the food and the room; warm ground allowed when it is the real interior, not by default
Recommended Effects: One soft hero move; menu section jump links; no carousels
Conversion Optimization: Menu in text, not a PDF; hours stated for today; booking or order one tap away; keep photos of your own food
Use When: People look up where to eat now and check the menu on the way
Avoid When: The business sells delivery only; use the ordering patterns
Mobile: Hours, phone, map and menu are the first four things
Accessibility: Menu text is real text (SC 1.4.5); allergen notes plain; maps have an address text alternative
Slop Habits: menu as a downloaded PDF; stock food photography; a serif hero with a trendy italic word

Aliases: Gym page|Studio schedule|Classes and free trial|Fitness joining page
Keywords: timetable, classes, gym, yoga, pilates, trial, membership, trainer, studio, schedule
Section Order: Free trial or first class offer > This week's timetable > Coaches > Prices and what is included > Facilities photos > Member reviews > Location and parking > Join form
Primary CTA Placement: Trial button in hero; per-class book link inside the timetable
Color Strategy: Energy from one saturated colour on a plain ground; check contrast on every state
Recommended Effects: Filter transitions; hover on classes; restrained motion
Conversion Optimization: Show the next class today, price in the open, cancellation rule, and what to bring
Use When: Customers pick by time and price and want to try before joining
Avoid When: A one-to-one trainer sells by consultation; use the professional enquiry pattern
Mobile: Timetable as a day list, not a wide grid
Accessibility: Timetable is a real table or list with headings (SC 1.3.1); filters are labelled
Slop Habits: a stock photo of a barbell at sunrise; 'transform your body' headline; countdown pressure on joining

Aliases: Photographer page|Tattoo studio page|Creative service page|Wedding photographer page
Keywords: portfolio, photographer, tattoo, artist, gallery, enquiry, packages, wedding, shoot, commission
Section Order: Best work large > Style statement in two lines > Packages or price from > Process and turnaround > Reviews or published credits > Availability and dates > Enquiry form
Primary CTA Placement: Enquire link on hero and after packages; availability beside it
Color Strategy: Let the work carry the colour; neutral frame with one accent
Recommended Effects: Gentle image transitions; lightbox with keyboard close; reduced motion respected
Conversion Optimization: Lead with the work that matches the buyer; give a price from; ask date and place first in the form; reply within a stated time
Use When: Buyers pick a person by taste and style, then check price
Avoid When: The work cannot be shown for confidentiality
Mobile: Images fill the width; enquiry is a short form
Accessibility: Alt text describes each photo (SC 1.1.1); lightbox traps and returns focus; no autoplay slideshow
Slop Habits: a masonry wall of unlabelled thumbnails; heavy parallax; filters that blur the work

Aliases: Property search page|Letting agent homepage|Property listings
Keywords: property, estate agent, listings, search, filters, map, valuation, viewing, rent, sale
Section Order: Search by place and price > Featured listings with real photos > Valuation call to action > Viewing booking > Team and branch > Areas covered > Reviews with sources
Primary CTA Placement: Search in hero; arrange a viewing on each listing; valuation call midway
Color Strategy: Neutral grounds so photos lead; one action colour
Recommended Effects: Image zoom; filter chip transitions; map pins with text list
Conversion Optimization: Save search and alerts; show price and key facts on cards; one-tap viewing request; honest 'sold' labels
Use When: People compare many properties and need fast filtering
Avoid When: The agent has three listings; use a simple portfolio page
Mobile: Filters in a sheet; card photos swipe
Accessibility: Map has a list equivalent; filter controls are labelled; photo alt text includes room
Slop Habits: stock house photos; filter overload; auto-playing virtual tour

Aliases: Box office page|Event landing|Show page|Conference page
Keywords: event, tickets, date, venue, programme, speakers, box office, seat, conference, show
Section Order: Name, date and place > Buy tickets > Programme or lineup > Venue and access > Ticket types and prices > Questions about refunds > Sponsors
Primary CTA Placement: Buy button pinned in header on scroll; repeated after the programme
Color Strategy: Bold event colour on a plain ground; limit to two colours
Recommended Effects: Countdown only if the date is real; poster-style type moves allowed
Conversion Optimization: All-in price visible; stock status honest; refund rule before checkout; add-to-calendar
Use When: A dated event needs sales or registrations
Avoid When: Always-open service; use booking instead
Mobile: Ticket selector in a sheet; Apple and Google wallet links after purchase
Accessibility: Venue access written out; countdown not announced every second (SC 4.1.3)
Slop Habits: fake sold-out scarcity; neon glow headings; unreadable date over a photo

Aliases: Hotel page|B and B page|Holiday let page|Venue hire page
Keywords: hotel, stay, rooms, availability, check in, rates, guesthouse, venue hire, holiday, book direct
Section Order: Dates and guests > Rooms with real photos and rates > What is included > Location and getting there > Reviews with source > Policies > Book direct reasons
Primary CTA Placement: Availability bar at the top of each page
Color Strategy: Colours from the building and place; avoid pastel gradient washes
Recommended Effects: Image galleries with captions; date picker highlights
Conversion Optimization: Show the total price before the last step; explain cancellation; stress direct benefits that are real
Use When: Guests choose a place to stay from photos and price
Avoid When: The business is a chain with a central booking engine; follow that engine's flow
Mobile: Date picker as a full sheet; sticky book button
Accessibility: Accessible-room details written out; date picker keyboard usable
Slop Habits: drone photo with a gradient overlay; 'escape the ordinary' headlines; hidden fees until checkout

Aliases: Farm shop page|Florist shop page|Market stall page|Small shop
Keywords: shop, local, florist, farm shop, catalogue, order, click and collect, seasonal, delivery area, market
Section Order: Opening times and place > Seasonal or best sellers > Order or reserve > Delivery or collection rules > The people behind it > Reviews > Contact
Primary CTA Placement: Order or reserve on each product; phone for custom orders
Color Strategy: Colours from the produce; neutral ground
Recommended Effects: Image hover swap; basket count update
Conversion Optimization: Make stock real; show cut-off times; allow phone orders; photos of actual goods
Use When: A small shop sells a changing range to nearby people
Avoid When: A national catalogue with thousands of items; use a full shop pattern

Accessibility: Basket changes announced (SC 4.1.3); price in text

Aliases: Charity page|Fundraising page|Appeal page|Give page
Keywords: donate, charity, impact, appeal, fundraising, gift aid, volunteer, trustees, cause, giving
Section Order: The need in one concrete story > Give now with amounts > What each amount does > Where the money goes with the latest accounts > Volunteer or other ways > Trustees and registration number > Thanks and receipts
Primary CTA Placement: Donate button in header, hero and after the impact figures
Color Strategy: Warm human colours from real photos; one action colour for give
Recommended Effects: Progress bar only if figures are real; amount selection feedback
Conversion Optimization: Preselect a sensible amount; offer monthly and one-off; reduce checkout fields; show the charity number; say what happens to a gift
Use When: A cause relies on small gifts and trust
Avoid When: Corporate sponsorship only
Mobile: Amount buttons large; wallet pay available
Accessibility: Amount choice is a radio group; errors described; no emotional timers
Slop Habits: guilt imagery; invented impact numbers; a progress thermometer that never moves

Aliases: Local directory|Find a provider|Listings with search|Marketplace listing
Keywords: directory, listings, search, categories, providers, filters, reviews, map, find, marketplace

Aliases: Course page|Tutor page|Lesson booking|School class page|Driving lessons page
Keywords: course, syllabus, enrol, lessons, tutor, teacher, curriculum, pricing, timetable, learn

Aliases: Transformation gallery|Job gallery|Results page|Makeover page
Keywords: before, after, results, gallery, transformation, renovation, cleaning, painting, landscaping, proof
Section Order: Best result with the brief > Gallery with same-angle photos > What was done and how long > Cost band > Customer words > Quote or book link

Aliases: Treatment menu|Salon price list|Service menu|Package page

Aliases: School page|Nursery page|Childcare page|Care home page
